philosophy.lowResponse: Respond during the current operating period.
philosophy.mediumResponse: Respond promptly before production can continue or degradation escalates.
philosophy.highResponse: Respond immediately to contain a material equipment or product consequence.
philosophy.shelving: Shelving suppresses annunciation only, never control, and expires automatically.

TASK_OVERRUN.action: Reduce task load and inspect the longest-running PLC work before restarting.
TASK_OVERRUN.consequence: Deterministic control timing may be lost.

TASK_JITTER_HIGH.action: Inspect task load, priorities, and external timing disturbance.
TASK_JITTER_HIGH.consequence: Timing-dependent behavior and measurements may become less reliable.

CPU_LOAD_HIGH.action: Identify sustained CPU consumers and restore controller capacity.
CPU_LOAD_HIGH.consequence: Task deadlines may be missed if load increases.

MEMORY_LOW.action: Stop nonessential consumers and investigate controller memory growth.
MEMORY_LOW.consequence: The runtime may become unstable or reject new work.

IPC_TEMP_HIGH.action: Check cabinet cooling, filters, fans, and ambient temperature.
IPC_TEMP_HIGH.consequence: The controller may throttle or stop to protect hardware.

FIELDBUS_MASTER_FAULT.action: Inspect the fieldbus master state, cabling, power, and first failed node.
FIELDBUS_MASTER_FAULT.consequence: Field devices are unavailable or no longer trustworthy.

DC_SYNC_LOST.action: Inspect distributed-clock reference, cabling, and slave synchronization state.
DC_SYNC_LOST.consequence: Synchronized motion and timestamps may drift.

TIME_SYNC_LOST.action: Restore the configured plant time source and verify offset convergence.
TIME_SYNC_LOST.consequence: Wall-clock event ordering cannot be trusted across systems.

UTILITY_DEVIATION.action: Restore the named utility to its qualified operating range.
UTILITY_DEVIATION.consequence: Equipment operation may be inhibited or process quality degraded.

IPC_FAN_FAULT.action: Inspect and replace the indicated IPC or cabinet fan.
IPC_FAN_FAULT.consequence: Controller temperature may rise and shorten equipment life.

STORAGE_HEALTH_LOW.action: Back up required data and replace the degrading storage device.
STORAGE_HEALTH_LOW.consequence: Logs, recipes, or runtime data may be lost.

CONTROLLER_METRICS_UNAVAILABLE.action: Verify the target health probe and required platform services are configured.

TIMEOUT.action: Inspect the named awaited condition and its owning module before resetting.
TIMEOUT.consequence: The command or sequence cannot complete in its allowed time.

PERMISSIVE_NOT_MET.action: Restore every failed permissive shown in the release report.

INTERLOCK_DROPPED.action: Restore the first-out interlock and inspect why it changed during operation.
INTERLOCK_DROPPED.consequence: Outputs are withdrawn and the active operation cannot continue.

RECIPE_INVALID.action: Select or repair a recipe whose schema and values validate for the complete subtree.
RECIPE_INVALID.consequence: Changeover is rejected without applying partial configuration.

STEP_STALLED.action: Follow the current-step pending condition to the named source module.
STEP_STALLED.consequence: The sequence is waiting longer than expected.

RETRY_EXHAUSTED.action: Correct the repeated underlying failure before resetting the retry state.
RETRY_EXHAUSTED.consequence: Automatic recovery has stopped and production cannot continue.

CYCLE_TIME_DEGRADED.action: Inspect the named step or command trend and plan corrective maintenance.
CYCLE_TIME_DEGRADED.consequence: Throughput is degrading even though production may continue.

UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND.action: Correct the caller or command catalog to use a supported command value.

LINK_TIMEOUT.action: Inspect the named connection, peer availability, and network path.
LINK_TIMEOUT.consequence: The external device or service is no longer communicating.

DEVICE_NOT_READY.action: Restore the external device to its documented ready state.
DEVICE_NOT_READY.consequence: The requested device operation remains unavailable.

DEVICE_PROTOCOL_ERROR.action: Verify the device profile, configured protocol, and received response.
DEVICE_PROTOCOL_ERROR.consequence: Device data cannot be interpreted reliably.

CARRIER_READ_FAILED.action: Inspect the carrier reader, identity medium, and provider connection.
CARRIER_READ_FAILED.consequence: Part identity and genealogy cannot be established.

CARRIER_WRITE_FAILED.action: Restore the carrier provider and write the result before releasing the part.
CARRIER_WRITE_FAILED.consequence: The production result may not follow the physical part.

PART_ID_MISMATCH.action: Contain the part and reconcile its physical identity with the active record.
PART_ID_MISMATCH.consequence: Genealogy or processing could be assigned to the wrong part.

RESULT_RECORD_REJECTED.action: Correct the result schema or capacity before reprocessing or releasing the part.
RESULT_RECORD_REJECTED.consequence: Required quality evidence was not recorded.

EVENT_PART_RECEIVED.consequence: Part identity was confirmed at station entry.

EVENT_PART_PROCESSING_STARTED.consequence: Value-adding processing started for the part.

EVENT_PART_PROCESSING_ABORTED.consequence: The part left processing without a completed result.

COMMISSIONING_GATE_ACTIVE.action: Rebuild and download this station without the named engineering gate before FAT/SAT and before production release (Core 7.5).
COMMISSIONING_GATE_ACTIVE.consequence: This controller is running a commissioning build that deliberately departs from its production configuration.

TEST_FAULT.consequence: Framework self-test fault; never raised in production.

CYL_NOT_EXTENDED.action: Inspect air supply, valve output, mechanics, and the extended sensor.
CYL_NOT_EXTENDED.consequence: The cylinder cannot prove its extended position.

CYL_NOT_RETRACTED.action: Inspect air supply, valve output, mechanics, and the retracted sensor.
CYL_NOT_RETRACTED.consequence: The cylinder cannot prove its retracted position.

CYL_BOTH_SENSORS.action: Stop operation and correct the contradictory cylinder sensor state.
CYL_BOTH_SENSORS.consequence: Cylinder position is physically implausible and cannot be trusted.

CYL_HOME_NOT_REACHED.action: Inspect for a jam, verify air and valve operation, and check the home sensor.
CYL_HOME_NOT_REACHED.consequence: The cylinder cannot complete motion to home.

CYL_WORK_NOT_REACHED.action: Inspect for a jam, verify air and valve operation, and check the work sensor.
CYL_WORK_NOT_REACHED.consequence: The cylinder cannot complete motion to work.

CYL_POS_IMPLAUSIBLE.action: Stop operation and repair the contradictory position feedback.
CYL_POS_IMPLAUSIBLE.consequence: Cylinder position cannot be established safely or reliably.

CYL_SENSOR_LOST.action: Inspect the active position sensor, wiring, and mechanical target.
CYL_SENSOR_LOST.consequence: A previously proven cylinder position was lost.

CYL_CFG_INVALID.action: Correct cylinder travel, timeout, and sensor configuration and reload the recipe.
CYL_CFG_INVALID.consequence: The cylinder command cannot be executed with valid supervision.

CYL_DISCREPANCY.action: Inspect both redundant sensors, their targets, and wiring before resetting.
CYL_DISCREPANCY.consequence: Redundant position channels disagree beyond the qualified interval.

DEV_CHANNEL_FAULT.action: Inspect the byte-channel state, endpoint, cabling, and peer service.

DEV_RESP_TIMEOUT.action: Verify the device is connected, responsive, and using the configured terminator.
DEV_RESP_TIMEOUT.consequence: The requested response did not arrive in time.

DEV_PROTOCOL.action: Compare the received payload with the configured device profile.
DEV_PROTOCOL.consequence: The response was rejected and no trustworthy result is available.

DEV_NOT_CONNECTED.action: Open or restore the configured device connection before retrying.
DEV_NOT_CONNECTED.consequence: The device request was rejected while disconnected.

DEV_CFG_INVALID.action: Correct the endpoint, port, channel, framing, and profile configuration.

DEV_RX_OVERFLOW.action: Correct framing or payload bounds and inspect the unexpected device response.
DEV_RX_OVERFLOW.consequence: The complete response was not retained and cannot be trusted.

POWER_ENABLE_WITHHELD.action: Restore every named control-power permissive and rearm deliberately.
POWER_ENABLE_WITHHELD.consequence: The requested power group remains de-energized.

POWER_FEEDBACK_TIMEOUT.action: Inspect the contactor, feedback circuit, control supply, and power-group wiring.
POWER_FEEDBACK_TIMEOUT.consequence: Commanded and proven control-power states do not agree.

AIR_SWITCH_CONFLICT.action: Inspect both pressure-switch channels, wiring, and pneumatic pressure.
AIR_SWITCH_CONFLICT.consequence: Air availability cannot be proven from contradictory inputs.

CLAMP_NOT_CONFIRMED.action: Inspect every clamp child and restore the first unconfirmed clamp condition.
CLAMP_NOT_CONFIRMED.consequence: The equipment module cannot prove the requested clamp state.

SEP_NO_CARRIER_AT.action: Check upstream feed, the carrier-at sensor, and that a carrier actually reached the separator.
SEP_NO_CARRIER_AT.consequence: No carrier was present to release, so the cycle cannot proceed.

SEP_CARRIER_NOT_CLEARED.action: Inspect the stopper mechanics, air supply and valve output, and the carrier-at sensor for a stuck signal.
SEP_CARRIER_NOT_CLEARED.consequence: The carrier did not leave the separator, so a jam is likely.

SEP_CARRIER_NOT_ARRIVED.action: Check the downstream conveyor is running and inspect the carrier-after sensor.
SEP_CARRIER_NOT_ARRIVED.consequence: The released carrier was not detected downstream and may be lost or stalled.

SEP_NOT_OPENED_FB.action: Inspect the open-feedback sensor and the stopper mechanics; confirm the station is configured to use this feedback.
SEP_NOT_OPENED_FB.consequence: The separator cannot prove it opened, so a release cannot be trusted.

SEP_SON_NOT_CLEARED.action: Check for a carrier stopped on the downstream sensor and inspect that sensor for a stuck signal.
SEP_SON_NOT_CLEARED.consequence: The downstream position did not clear, so the next release would collide.

AXIS_TARGET_OOR.action: Correct the commanded target, or the soft limits in the recipe if the move is genuinely required.
AXIS_TARGET_OOR.consequence: The move was refused before any motion; the axis has not moved.

AXIS_MOVE_TIMEOUT.action: Check for a mechanical obstruction, and review the move timeout against the configured velocity and distance.
AXIS_MOVE_TIMEOUT.consequence: The axis did not reach its target in time and was stopped.

AXIS_DRIVE_FAULT.action: Read the drive's own diagnostic, clear the fault at the drive, then reset and re-home the axis.
AXIS_DRIVE_FAULT.consequence: The drive rejected or aborted the motion; the axis is not under control until reset.

AXIS_NOT_HOMED.action: Home the axis before commanding an absolute move.
AXIS_NOT_HOMED.consequence: Absolute positions are meaningless without a datum, so the move was refused.

ROBOT_NO_ROUTE.action: Check the robot route graph: the two positions have no connected transit path. Add the missing help-to-help link or correct the nest's help affinity.
ROBOT_NO_ROUTE.consequence: The move cannot be planned, so the sequence stops before the robot leaves its current position.

ROBOT_NO_HELP_FOR_NEST.action: Check the nest's help affinity: no serving help point is valid for this direction of travel. A one-way nest cannot be left the way it was entered unless a DEPART corridor is defined.
ROBOT_NO_HELP_FOR_NEST.consequence: The move cannot be planned; the robot holds position rather than approaching the nest from an untaught direction.

ROBOT_CONTROLLER_FAULT.action: Read the fault on the robot's own teach pendant or controller display - its text is carried in the diagnostic - clear the cause there, then acknowledge the controller before restarting the sequence.
ROBOT_CONTROLLER_FAULT.consequence: The robot has stopped and will accept no motion command until its own fault is acknowledged.

ROBOT_MOVE_TIMEOUT.action: Check for obstruction along the taught path, then acknowledge and repeat the command. If the robot reports its own fault, read it on the pendant first.
ROBOT_MOVE_TIMEOUT.consequence: The robot stopped mid-motion and the sequence cannot advance until the move is repeated.

ROBOT_NOT_REFERENCED.action: Home the robot before commanding motion. Run the HOME command, or reference from the robot controller, and wait for Referenced to turn true.
ROBOT_NOT_REFERENCED.consequence: Motion is refused because the robot has no valid position reference.

ROBOT_MODE_NOT_PERMITTED.action: Set the robot controller to Automatic/Remote mode and wait for the reported mode to change, then repeat the command. Jogging requires a manual mode instead.
ROBOT_MODE_NOT_PERMITTED.consequence: Motion is refused because the controller mode does not permit it.

ROBOT_PROTECTIVE_STOP.action: Clear the collision or crash-protection trip at the robot controller, check the tool and fixture for damage, then acknowledge the controller before restarting.
ROBOT_PROTECTIVE_STOP.consequence: The robot stopped on its protective device and accepts no motion until the trip is acknowledged there.

ROBOT_PARAM_OOR.action: Correct the commanded speed scale to the configured range for this product, or have engineering widen the band if the product genuinely needs it.
ROBOT_PARAM_OOR.consequence: The command is refused before motion because a parameter is outside its configured band.

ROBOT_RESUME_INVALID.action: The arm was moved while the sequence was held. Recover by driving to a defined position from the current area, or jog back to a known position, then restart the step.
ROBOT_RESUME_INVALID.consequence: The held motion cannot resume where it stopped; recovery is required before the sequence continues.

ROBOT_POINT_UNREACHABLE.action: Check that the correct tool and frame are selected for this product, then verify the taught point is still within reach. Re-teach the point if the fixture or gripper has changed.
ROBOT_POINT_UNREACHABLE.consequence: The move is refused before it starts because the robot cannot reach the commanded point with the tool and frame now active.

AXIS_JOG_NOT_ENABLED.action: Hold the enabling device on the handheld terminal in its middle position while jogging. If it is held and this persists, the enabling device or its safety connection needs attention before teaching continues.
AXIS_JOG_NOT_ENABLED.consequence: Manual jogging is refused because no safety-rated enabling device is currently permitting motion.

AXIS_JOG_RELEASED.action: None if you released the control deliberately. If you were still holding it, the connection to the panel was interrupted - check the handheld's link before jogging again.
AXIS_JOG_RELEASED.consequence: The axis stopped because the jog request stopped arriving.
